prov.text: Provision for Credit Losses . Based on an analysis of the factors described in “Critical Accounting Policies—Allowance for Credit Losses,” we recorded a provision for credit losses of $415,000 for the three months ended September 30, 2026, compared to a benefit of $320,000 for the three months ended September 30, 2025. The decrease in provision for credit losses on loans for the three months ended September 30, 2026 was primarily due to lower loan portfolio growth during the period.

nonop.text: Interest Expense . Interest expense totaled $7.0 million for the three months ended September 30, 2026 which represents an increase of $799,000, or 12.9%, compared to the same period in 2025. Interest expense on deposits increased $1.0 million, or 22.2%, to $5.7 million for the three months ended September 30, 2026. Our average balance of interest-bearing deposits increased $153.9 million, or 24.4%, to $783.4 million, while our average cost of deposits decreased 6 basis points to 2.91% for the three months ended September 30, 2026, from 2.97% for the three months ended September 30, 2025.

tax.text: Income Taxes. Income tax expense increased to $387,000 for the three months ended September 30, 2026, compared to $356,000 for the three months ended September 30, 2025. The effective tax rates were 23.4% and 27.0% for the three months ended September 30, 2026 and 2025, respectively, as we had higher levels of taxable income during the 2026 period.

ocf.text: Our cash flows are comprised of three primary classifications: cash flows from operating activities, investing activities, and financing activities. Net cash provided by operating activities was $2.2 million for the three months ended September 30, 2026 and $1.4 million for the three months ended September 30, 2025. Net cash used by investing activities, which consists primarily of disbursements for loan originations and the purchase of investment securities, offset by principal collections on loans and proceeds from maturing securities and pay downs on securities, was $44.5 million and $53.3 million for the three months ended September 30, 2026 and 2025, respectively. Net cash provided by financing activities was $45.5 million and $54.4 million for the three months ended September 30, 2026 and 2025, respectively.

Net interest income.text: Net Interest Income . Net interest income was $7.2 million for the three months ended September 30, 2026, compared to $5.7 million for the three months ended September 30, 2025, as our interest income increased faster than our interest expense. Our interest rate spread increased to 2.22% for the three months ended September 30, 2026 from 1.96% for the three months ended September 30, 2025. Our net interest margin increased to 2.67% for the three months ended September 30, 2026 from 2.49% for the three months ended September 30, 2025

intro.text: Winchester Bancorp, Inc. is the mid-tier holding company of Winchester Savings Bank and is the majority owned subsidiary of Winchester Bancorp, MHC. Winchester Savings Bank's mission is to operate and grow a profitable community-oriented financial institution that is dedicated to meeting the banking needs of individuals and small businesses in the communities in which it operates.
